dedupe_keys.name: dynamic ambulance relocation qubo formulations and an equity aware extension

description: The ambulance-relocation research team publishes a reproducibility package with quadratic unconstrained binary optimisation formulations, an equity-aware extension and a discrete-event simulator. Zenodo provides the archive under CC BY 4.0. The page says the package contains a seven-solver classical benchmark and stored results from two studies evaluated against five years of dispatch records from San Francisco and Staten Island. This model can compare dynamic relocation strategies, response coverage and distributional effects in emergency-medical-service simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. Coverage is the two reported service contexts and chosen solver settings, not evidence that a relocation policy would work in every jurisdiction. A limitation is that the public description does not establish whether raw dispatch records are redistributed in the ZIP or only derived test cases and stored results. The objective weights and equity definition govern comparisons. No archive was downloaded or solver and simulator run reproduced.
